title: continuous-batcher: scheduler tuning to prevent starvation, reduce queueing and timeouts
author: Asha Patel
description: Summary: Tune continuous batcher scheduler to reduce queueing latency and prevent starvation/timeouts for small, latency-sensitive requests. Motivation: recent production incidents showed long tail queueing for low-token, low-cost requests when large-context batches dominated the queue. This change introduces per-priority queueing, adaptive admission timeouts, and a simple fairness token so small requests can't be starved indefinitely. Changes include a new scheduling policy (priority windows + aging), configurable per-customer fairness weight, updated metrics for queue wait distribution, and safety defaults that preserve throughput for bulk batch workloads. Includes unit and integration tests, benchmark results, rollout plan, and CLI knobs for tuning.
